author: Pursuit of Wonder
description:
Want to restore the planet’s ecosystems and see your impact in monthly videos? The first 100 people to join Planet Wild with my code PURSUIT8 will get the first month paid for by me: https://planetwild.com/r/pursuitofwonder/join
If you want to get to know them better first, check out their Lake Victoria mission: https://planetwild.com/r/pursuitofwonder/m39

In this video, we explore how a simple toaster can reveal how interconnected and absurd modern civilization truly is. How have we arrived at a place in history where complex, previously unfathomable technologies arrive at our doorsteps in mere days or hours? This wasn't inevitable. And it isn't to be expected given the nature of all other animals on Earth. Humanity is hellbent on "progress" carried out by the vast networks of interconnected industries it's created. But why? Why are we so different from the rest of the species of the world? What do we really want?
